title: A First Guess Is Rarely the Final Answer: Learned Local Search That Generalizes to Larger Routing Problems
abstract: arXiv:2604.06940v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural routing solvers rarely stop at their first solution: constructed tours are usually refined by search, such as sampling or local search. Neural improvement methods learn this search as a policy that repeatedly applies local moves, but existing policies degrade sharply beyond their training size. We argue that size generalization depends on whether the information that determines the value of a move reaches the policy in a size-independent form, and identify three places where existing policies fall short: the representation of the incumbent solution, the scale of the input features, and the computation of move gains. translated_title: 初步猜测很少是最终答案：可泛化至更大规模路径问题的学习式局部搜索
translated_abstract: 神经路径求解器很少止步于其首个解：构造出的路径通常会通过搜索（如采样或局部搜索）进行改进。神经改进方法将这种搜索学习为一个反复应用局部移动的策略，但现有策略在超出训练规模时性能会急剧下降。我们认为，规模泛化能力取决于决定移动价值的信息是否以与规模无关的形式传递给策略，并指出现有策略在三个方面的不足：当前解的表示、输入特征的尺度，以及移动增益的计算。我们在 NICO 中解决了这三个问题——NICO 是一种用于路径问题的可学习 2-opt 策略，它通过解的边来表示当前解（每条边一个 token，不使用位置编码），用无尺度特征描述这些边，并将每个移动的精确增益加到其 logit 中，从而使网络学习对贪心搜索的修正。
tldr: 该论文提出 NICO，一种可学习的 2-opt 局部搜索策略，通过规模无关的解表示、无尺度特征和精确移动增益计算，实现了对超出训练规模的更大路径问题的高效泛化。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes NICO, a learned 2-opt local search policy that generalizes to larger routing problems through size-independent solution representation, scale-free features, and exact move gain computation.
